definitions.explanation: Relating to or occurring in ordinary daily life. Describes things that are part of one's regular, unremarkable routine.

examples.japanese: {日常的|にちじょうてき}に{運動|うんどう}する。
examples.english: I exercise on a daily basis.

examples.japanese: この{地域|ちいき}では{地震|じしん}は{日常的|にちじょうてき}なことだ。
examples.english: Earthquakes are an everyday occurrence in this area.

examples.japanese: {日常的|にちじょうてき}な{会話|かいわ}で{使|つか}われる{表現|ひょうげん}を{学|まな}びたい。
examples.english: I want to learn expressions used in everyday conversation.

notes:
USAGE:
The adverb form {日常的|にちじょうてき}に is very common. Contrasts with {非日常的|ひにちじょうてき} (extraordinary, out of the ordinary).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {日常的|にちじょうてき}に{使|つか}う (to use on a daily basis)
- {日常的|にちじょうてき}な{光景|こうけい} (everyday scene)
- {日常的|にちじょうてき}な{生活|せいかつ} (daily life)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {日常|にちじょう}: everyday, daily life — the noun form
- {普段|ふだん}: usually, normally — more casual, adverbial
